title: Charcoal for the Smith
offer: My fire needs charcoal, lots of it! Old Grim burns charcoal in the woods by Svanetorp. Bring me seven sacks; it will take you more than one trip.

steps.load_say: Black as night and light as a feather. Mind your dresses!

steps.say: Now my fire roars! Here, for your help: silver, and a little iron nail for luck.

fact: Smiths burned charcoal, not wood: it burns much hotter and melts the iron.
